summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET web page within HSPnet. It provides a staff administrative interface for listing student employment applications with filtering and administration options. The interface displays the current user's name and last login details, allows filtering by Site, Discipline, date range, and withdrawn status, and supports grid-based listing with paging. It enforces strict front-end and back-end validation for dates, uses AJAX controls, and provides user feedback panels for errors and warnings.
purpose: To allow staff administrators to view, filter, and manage student employment applications within HSPnet, using a grid interface with flexible filtering (Site, Discipline, Date Range, Withdrawn/Active), quick access to application details, and validation/error handling.
actors: Staff Admin (current user, as determined by UserSession)

workflows.name: View and Filter Employment Applications
steps: Page loads and initializes user/session context.
User's last login is retrieved and displayed.
Site and Discipline dropdowns are populated based on agency and session.
Default dates are set to past 3 months (start) through today (end).
User can filter applications by selecting Site, Discipline, and date range.
User can include/exclude withdrawn applications via checkbox.
User triggers data retrieval with the refresh button.
Grid updates with matching application rows. Shows Name, Site, Submission Date, Status (Withdrawn/Submitted), WithdrawnDate, agency, and program.
Users can click names for detail popups and emails for mailto links.
Errors and warnings display in floating panels (AJAX Extender).

business_rules: Withdrawn applications can be toggled to show/hide via checkbox.
StartDate and EndDate are both required and must be valid dates.
Filters (Site, Discipline) default to agency-wide/all if not explicitly chosen.
Paging is enabled, 50 rows per page.
validations: StartDate/EndDate use RegularExpressionValidator to ensure valid date format.
All validation uses ValidationSummary tied to 'currentview' group.
calculations: Default StartDate is 3 months before current date.
Withdrawn/Submitted status is calculated based on whether WithdrawnDate is null.
Display of WithdrawnDate only occurs if applicable.
conditions: If SiteID is in URL query, use it; otherwise, default to all for agency.
If a discipline/subdiscipline is chosen, filter accordingly.
If user triggers refresh or changes filter, rebind grid.
system_behavior: AJAX controls keep warning/error panels floating.
Grid triggers RowDataBound for setting up hyperlinks and email links.
Client-side JS validates date logic pre-submission.
dependencies: UserSession properties (e.g., AgencyID, PreferredFirstName, LastLogin, TimeZoneDescription)
exceptions: Invalid or missing required fields (dates, etc.) block grid refresh and prompt errors.
If no data is found, grid displays an 'empty' message.
content_gaps: No explicit documentation of user roles/permissions, assumed to be staff admin.
No explicit description of security model or access controls.
No explicit details on data returned in grid rows beyond field bindings.
No high-level architectural diagram or summary.
